title: Mixed Event — The Climax! Kamiyama Cheer Squad! — Episode2 For the Sports Festival

meta.Event Outline: With the Sports Festival just around the corner, Kamiyama High School is abuzz with talk of the renowned cheering competition, which also piques Rui's interest. Suddenly, Mizuki approaches him with a request...

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The passion you feel for the Sports Festival...?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Yes. I believe in the power that cheering can bestow upon others. As such, I've been on the cheer squad for the Sports Festival every time since I was a first year.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: I've dedicated my entire high school life to the cheer squad... However, I had the misfortune of losing to my archrival last time.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: The blue team won the sports portion, but the red team managed to pull off a comeback by receiving the most votes during the cheering competition.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, the captain mentioned that.
Our teacher said the same thing today too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That was a pretty big shock, right?
Everyone apparently thought the blue team already had it in the books.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
And I was on the blue team...
This sense of regret wells up inside of me every time I think about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: But regret isn't all that I've been feeling. Since then, I've spent quite a lot of time thinking about why we lost that time.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
That's when I made a realization.
The joy I felt after winning during my first year drove me towards becoming obsessed with defeating my archrival.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: The power that cheering can bestow upon others... I'd forgotten all about the people I initially hoped to empower and encourage.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Losing was simply the natural outcome of that. Nonetheless, I'll be seeking revenge as I participate in my final cheering competition...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: I want to win it while getting the festivities to reach a fever pitch. I want everyone to be glad they were on the blue team and make this the best Sports Festival ever for them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (A fever pitch, eh...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
I think I understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: You do?!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I knew you would, Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You did...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Shiraishi also said that you asked for me specifically... Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, that? It sounded like the captain already knew about you, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: When I had to come up with ideas for the cheer squad on my own, I kept hitting so many mental blocks...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Then, I just happened to see one of your shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: One of our shows?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Yes. The way the actors drew the audience into their breathtaking world... All the warmth I felt just by watching the story unfold...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: I became convinced that the director of that show would know how to turn my ideas for the cheering competition into reality!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
And so, you asked to meet with me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You should've seen the look on the captain's face when I said that we're friends.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What if this is more than just a coincidence?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, Kamishiro, the ball's in your court...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm grateful for everything you mentioned just now and I am interested, but...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: I understand that you're a very busy person, Kamishiro. But before you make your decision, please let me ask you about my ideas for the competition. I've been working on them since the previous Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: You said that you'd like to know what I had in mind, no? If that's true, take a look at this.
se_event_cheerteam_2022_006

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is as thick as a dictionary. Are these all your ideas?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
No, not all of them.
I still have two or three more stacks.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait, there's more of these?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. I'm pretty sure anyone would freeze up when a giant stack of papers is dumped in front of them like this. I honestly had the same reaction.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But seeing this for myself...
It kinda changed my impression.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We drew straws to see who'd be chosen for the cheer squad. I hate to say it now, but I wasn't all that interested at first...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: ...is how I feel going into the cheering competition. Will you help me?!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I was really glad An was also chosen, but stuff that encourages “camaraderie” still really isn't my thing...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Unfortunately, I don't really have a choice now.)

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: The cheering competition itself will proceed as I just mentioned. Now, I'd like it if you could all take a look at the ideas I've come up for it. Don't be afraid to give me your honest opinion.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Wait, this is thicker than a dictionary... He came up with all of these?!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (F-For now, I'll read through some of them.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Alright, let's see...
Gather all the blue team members' headbands to make a big ring. Okay, seems pretty standard.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(But it says, “Rejected.”
Oh, it doesn't go with the theme... I guess so.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(What about this page?
Oh, specs for all the equipment being used for the Sports Festival. Here are the heights for the platform and flagpoles...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Wait, did the captain look up all this stuff on his own? Does that mean he climbed the flagpoles to get these measurements...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(And these other ideas...
I was expecting to see a big mess of scribbled notes, but that's not the case at all.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Jumping into a fire while twirling a weapon around... It wouldn't be easy, but it would look so cool if we pulled that off.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Oh, wait...
“Rejected. The school won't allow us to use fire.”)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(That's too bad...
If it were me, I'd have a video...)

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
What do you think?
Anything catch your interest?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, mind if I say something?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The one that involves soldiers marching around. I think it'd look really cool if they did dance steps in unison...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Oh?
Can you expand on that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um... I saw some other people do it at this one event. I can't describe it right now, but I'll be sure to look it up later tonight! I really think it'll go well with this idea!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's already in the mood to get this off the ground.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, I can see why too...)

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Yes, excellent!
We can discuss that tomorrow.
Alright, Akiyama, how about you...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh?
M-Me...? Um...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
W-Well...
The one that involves using fire...
I think it's really unfortunate that it's been rejected.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I get that fire makes things tricky...
However, we could just show a video instead. That way, we'd also be able to do all sorts of other stuff!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Just kidding...!
I mean, you already rejected it once, so we should probably think of something different...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
I like it!
Let's keep that in mind as we move forward.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: This was actually one of my favorite ideas, so it pained me to have to give up on it...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: But a video would definitely make that possible! Thank you for this, Akiyama!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: B-But... I literally came up with that just now? Are you sure you want to run with it?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Nonsense. I asked for your honest opinion, no? Not only did you and Shiraishi do just that, you even came up with your own ideas.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: And it's clear to me that your suggestions would result in a better outcome, so there's no reason to not consider them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (A better outcome...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's not exactly the same, but this process feels kinda similar to when we're making music.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That made me want to become a better video editor and learn how to be more evocative.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
...is what happened.
After that, I was totally on board with everything.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
It must've been a tremendous idea if it got you this excited about it, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
At the same time...
I think I understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (To be honest, these ideas by themselves are rather crude. They don't fit together well and leave much to be desired.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, even a professional director would struggle to come up with so many ideas for one theme...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This must be the passion he was talking about...)

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: I want to win it while getting the festivities to reach a fever pitch. I want everyone to be glad they were on the blue team and make this the best Sports Festival ever for them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “The power that cheering can bestow upon others,” huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (When I first heard that, it reminded me of my own dream... “To make others smile through my shows.” In that case...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This may be worth a try.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I accept your offer.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Captain, I'll do my best to come up with a performance that grants everyone the power you mentioned before.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: K-Kamishiro...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
This is gonna be the best cheering competition ever!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Way to go, Captain!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: But I really need to thank you both for letting Kamishiro know about this, Akiyama, Shiraishi! I couldn't be more grateful!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that we've settled that, we can look forward to getting things rolling tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, Mizuki, there's something I'd like you to do as we get ready for the day of. Mind lending me a hand?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Me?
